# PluginEasy

> Official verified directory for free mobile plugins, popular game enhancements, and signed installer packages for iOS and Android.

## Main Resources
- [PluginEasy Homepage](https://plugineasy.comee.online/): Main catalog of 72 verified iOS & Android plugins and popular games.
- [Free iOS Plugins](https://plugineasy.comee.online/free-ios-plugins.html): Verified iOS tweaks and plugins without jailbreak.
- [Free Android Mods](https://plugineasy.comee.online/free-android-mods.html): Tested Android mod menus and signed APK releases.
- [Mobile Game Plugins](https://plugineasy.comee.online/mobile-game-plugins.html): Popular game plugins including Brawl Stars, GTA, Minecraft, Free Fire, PUBG, and Pokemon GO.
- [Security & Safety Verification](https://plugineasy.comee.online/plugineasy-com-safe.html): MSSC 2026 cryptographic signature and sandbox safety report.
- [About PluginEasy](https://plugineasy.comee.online/about.html): Editorial team, verification methodology, and contact information.
